metadata.documentation: Preliminary 5 minute averaged surface meteorology and flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the INFUSSE campaign. The winds reported by the 3D sonic anemometers are in instrument coordinates. For more information please check the ISARRA website.
